use_case: Computer-vision crop yield prediction from drone imagery (field-level watermelon yield estimates 1 to 2 weeks ahead; cotton boll counts proposed for fall 2026)
vendor_or_model: Agronomy analytics vendor (SaaS computer-vision model, SYS-09)
source_evidence: EV-022 (vendor account and click-through terms); EV-054 (pilot accuracy and bias comparison)
data_categories: Drone RGB and multispectral imagery; field boundaries; variety and planting dates; past field yields from load records (no personal data; people may appear incidentally in images)
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: crew hours offered for harvest support; incidental images of people)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; escalates to Employment if used to set H-2A job order worker numbers or to cut hours without review, or to Safety/CI if linked to irrigation or variable-rate prescriptions that run automatically
human_in_the_loop: Owner and General Manager checks each estimate against hand counts before any load commitment or crew plan; no crew hours cut on an estimate alone
applicable_laws: 20 CFR 655.122(i) three-fourths guarantee and 655.122(j)(1) hours-offered records (indirect); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor accuracy claims); NIST AI RMF 1.0 as guidance
status: Approved with conditions (due 2026-10-31); advisory use only for the 2027 watermelon season; cotton trial advisory only

use_case: General-purpose public generative AI chatbots used by office staff to draft letters and emails
source_evidence: EV-037 (staff AI tool question); EV-023 (no generative AI tool charges)
data_categories: Risk of worker personal information, yields, or load and price terms being pasted
risk_tier: Low (High if Restricted data were entered)
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) reasonable measures if personal information were entered; NIST AI 600-1 used as guidance
status: Not on the approved-tools list; prohibited for Restricted and Internal information (POL-04 4.6; POL-02 C.2)
